channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Grant Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Grant Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Grant Williams
item.description:
Bucks’ Bobby Portis on @Stadium:

“When I got hints of it, I’m like, ain’t no way I’m getting traded for...excuse my French, that’s my guy, I love competing against him...but I shouldn’t get traded for Grant Williams. That don’t even sound right.”

Bobby Portis on Grant Williams, Apr 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @ShamsCharania.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Grant Williams
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Doncic on what it was like to see Grant Williams tonight:

“He's a great guy. But I think you can see what P.J. brings to our team. I think the trade was great for us. But Grant is a great guy. We have a good relationship. Some people say we don't, but we do.”

Luka Doncic on Grant Williams, Apr 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Michael Finley on Grant Williams
item.description:
“One day in practice, a player on our team, I won’t call his name out — but it’s Grant Williams. He decided he wanted to get under Luka’s skin. He felt Luka didn’t come that day ready to practice. To make a long story short, they had a scrimmage going and he was talking trash to Luka up and down the court. So finally, Luka says ‘Okay,”

Michael Finley on Grant Williams, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Devin Booker on Grant Williams
item.description:
Nonetheless, Devin Booker knows that it's the Suns who had the last laugh in their demolition of the Kyrie Irving-less Mavericks, with Booker even going as far as to say that Williams only had one mission entering the game, and that mission wasn't to play basketball.

“Hell yeah, it's not necessary. I don't think Grant Williams wanted to play basketball tonight. He wants to do the antics, man. We're out there trying to hoop. So big props to Nurk for holding that down. If I would've seen that, I would do the same thing. That's how we get down. We're not with the nonsense,”

Devin Booker on Grant Williams, Jan 25, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Grant Williams
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on if he's ready to see Grant Williams tomorrow:

“Not really. No, I love Grant. I'm sure he'll be ready to have an annoying game.”

Jaylen Brown on Grant Williams, Jan 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Caleb Martin on Jimmy Butler, Grant Williams
item.description:
Caleb Martin on what went through his head when he saw the Jimmy Butler-Grant Williams moment:

“I knew that was gonna be good for us, knowing Jimmy... We'll take mad Jimmy any time. You could see it in his eyes he was ready to go after that.”

Caleb Martin on Jimmy Butler, Grant Williams, May 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Grant Williams:

“He’s in the Smart category where when he’s on the floor, we’re able to just be really dynamic defensively because of his versatility, his communication, his toughness and his ability to guard different matchups.”

Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams, May 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams
item.description:
Quin Snyder said BOS is unique:

“When you move to the defensive end, they are equally unique. They've got Williams, they've got rim protection, they have the ability to switch. They've got Marcus Smart, who to me is an elite player and possibly the best leader in the NBA.”

Quin Snyder on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams, Apr 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Grant Williams
item.description:
Tatum explained, via ClutchPoints Twitter.

“I ain’t got no ego, I’m just trying to win. Joe [Mazulla] can draw up a play for me, but there’s other options… I’m not mad that Grant [Williams] took that shot and didn’t pass it to me. It’s basketball.”

Jayson Tatum on Grant Williams, Mar 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Grant Williams
item.description:
While it’s definitely frustrating for the Celtics to lose a very winnable game, Tatum emphasized that it’s just part of basketball.

“I’m not frustrated at Grant [Williams]. If he made it, everybody would be happy… It is what it is,”

Jayson Tatum on Grant Williams, Mar 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Grant Williams
item.description:
Jay King:Tom Thibodeau:

“A guy like Grant Williams I don’t underestimate. I know how good he is.”

Tom Thibodeau on Grant Williams, Oct 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Josh Richardson on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams
item.description:
Brian Robb:Josh Richardson on Celtics training camp intensity and the Smart/Grant Williams spat:

“The competitive spirit is great. I like when it gets chippy like that.”

Josh Richardson on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams, Oct 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.
